title: DOLE Department Order
description: Schema for Philippine Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Department Orders

order_number.description: DOLE Order number (e.g., 'DO-202-19', 'DO-174-17'; lettered amendments as 'DO-18-A-11')

title.description: Full title of the Department Order

effective_date.description: Date when the order becomes effective (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when the document alone does not determine it, e.g. 'fifteen (15) days after publication' with no known publication date

source_url.description: Official source URL (Official Gazette, DOLE website, etc.)

issuing_authority.description: Name and title of the issuing official

supersedes.description: List of previous order numbers that this order supersedes or amends

related_laws.description: Related Republic Acts, Labor Code articles, or other legal references

published_date.description: Date when the order was officially published

signed_date.description: Date the order was signed, taken from the signature block

effectivity_clause.description: Sentence stating when the order takes effect, whitespace-normalized (e.g. 'This Order shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.')

sections.description: Hierarchical structure of the order's content

content.description: Full text content of the section, enumerated items included (they are also broken out in `subsections`)
